Everyone is debating whether the midterm results will derail AI. I think investors are overlooking a more important risk: how much announced AI infrastructure will actually get built and energized?Consider two findings:

1. Local opposition is becoming a real development constraint.

By my count of Ballotpedia’s list, 40 of the 41 local data-center measures decided on November 3 went against development: bans, MW caps, moratoria and rejected rezonings. Nine were advisory, so not all are binding, but the direction is striking.

2. Utility filings reveal demand long before the public announcements.
